constraints.statement: Only the explicitly listed strategies should be compared: trees, reflective roofs, green roofs, shade structures, and cooling centers.
Evaluation must be performed on the four requested criteria: effectiveness, cost, equity, and scalability.
The comparison context is dense cities.

goals.statement: Identify how well urban heat-mitigation strategies perform in dense cities.
Compare trees, reflective roofs, green roofs, shade structures, and cooling centers.
Use effectiveness, cost, equity, and scalability as the comparison dimensions.
Determine which strategy or strategies perform best under the requested criteria.

outcomes.description: A comparative assessment that ranks or profiles the five specified strategies in dense cities across effectiveness, cost, equity, and scalability.
A recommendation summary of tradeoffs across the four criteria to support selecting the best-performing strategy set.

unknowns.question: What operational definition of "dense cities" should govern the comparison (e.g., density thresholds or urban form categories)?
How should "works best" be operationalized across criteria (single weighted score, multi-criteria ranking, or criterion-by-criterion recommendations)?
What cost/effectiveness units and normalizations are expected (for example, per-building, per-area, annualized, and lifecycle timing)?
